scope: Display preferences and nested Diary/Calendar Settings with canonical diary consumers.

Expose functional cloud consumers, including Summary Column and Group Subtotals under source Diary Settings navigation.
Replace navigation, default settings and transport references with account projection/callback ownership.
Keep pending save controls frozen with explicit retry; do not show explanatory paragraphs.
Restore Calendar Settings, show/hide groups, always-explode meals, group rename and per-group Quick Add; omit Health Connect.
Reuse the already-published source row/dialog CSS; cloud switch sizing and host rules live in display.css.

Reuse canonical projectDiaryTarget, exerciseEntryFacts, energy units and locale owners already published for Report/Dashboard.

Retain grouped rows, collapsed Diary Groups and Quick Add navigation; use canonical account settings and concise English labels.

contracts: Authenticated revision-bearing GET /api/display returns effective settings for the account.
display.save is a narrow patch; energy and theme use canonical validators, summary flags reuse diary-display-settings, unrelated settings remain unchanged.
One immutable command envelope is retained until its receipt and refreshed account state are acknowledged.
System theme uses the existing appearance owner; Diary consumes canonical energy conversion, timestamp setting, summary policy and hydration visibility.
GET /api/display adds canonical summaryNutrients and effective diaryTable policy; display.save validates a complete diaryTable object and preserves all unrelated settings.
Diary cells read canonical entry facts; group rows consume summary.diaryTable, without UI recalculation or subtracting exercise from food intake. Selection mode does not change whole-group totals.
Display owns child navigation; More supplies headerRoot. Child Back returns to Display before More.

verification.result: Calendar/Display API and composition checks pass; shared Charts, Snapshots, record editors, photo and Oracle checks pass. Exact commands recorded in diary-calendar-source.json.
verification.browser: Actual public/diary.html and diary.js, production HTTP CSP, authenticated route and transactional in-memory Appwrite fixture, Chrome 412 x 915.
checks: 100 kcal source renders 418 kJ without changing stored nutrients.
Timestamp removed and energy/macros/highlights/water panels hidden; preferences persist through reload.
Units Cancel, modal Escape and outside click do not save; More Back does not focus search.
Rejected save restores canonical switch; lost successful reply retries identical envelope; stale revision offers Reload latest.
System theme tracks device color scheme. Other account and unrelated preference fields unchanged.
Summary Column Cancel and Group Subtotals Escape preserve account policy. Child Back returns Display.
Protein renders measured zero as 0 g, missing as an em dash and partial recipe as the recorded partial sum; inactive net carbohydrate is not zero.
Exercise displays negative converted energy, and N/A for nutrient columns. Empty groups display zero.
All four subtotal modes render from canonical summary; selection does not change group subtotals; macro layout has no horizontal overflow.
Calendar month projection, marker preferences and source picker selection/cancellation work end to end.
Show/hide groups, rename and explicit per-group Quick Add preserve canonical settings and existing record assignments.
Always Explode Meals changes future meal additions through the existing canonical command.
verification.fixture: Serve current source files and barcodeAssets() from locked dependencies; no dist/client dependency. Rejected-save assertion waits for the canonical display state and the actual 400 command response.
verification.hosted: scripts/verify-display-hosted.mjs extended and syntax checked; not run by this worker.

limitations: Language needs source locale routing across cloud labels and server-provided presentation; primary screens remain English.
No new physical-device comparison. Hosted verifier is prepared and unrun by this worker.
Font Size and Pause Life are restored in separate increments; see font-size-source.json and pause-life-source.json.
